nodes.name: ws_loop.rs
nodes.summary: Long-lived WebSocket task that connects, authenticates, and runs the read/write select loop for the WeCom AI Bot gateway, with heartbeat and reconnect backoff.

nodes.name: weixin.rs
nodes.summary: Personal WeChat (Weixin) channel via Tencent iLink Bot API: long-polls for inbound messages, sends replies, and tracks per-peer context tokens and allowlist policy.

nodes.name: config.rs
nodes.summary: Defines IntegrationsConfig, the app-level cross-agent persisted config (channels, databases, nodes, web search, embedding, MCP) with load/save to ~/.orgii/integrations.json.

nodes.name: binding.rs
nodes.summary: BindingStore pins an external chat (channel + chat_id [+ sender_id]) to a specific agent OS session, persisted in SQLite so bindings survive restarts.

nodes.name: channels_ops.rs
nodes.summary: Helpers that register enabled channels into the ChannelManager and construct/toggle a single channel instance by type for the gateway service.

nodes.name: commands.rs
nodes.summary: Parses inbound slash commands (/new, /reset, /status, /compact, /help) that control gateway session-binding behavior before a message reaches the agent.

nodes.name: message_merge.rs
nodes.summary: Per-session merge buffer that coalesces rapid-fire inbound messages (e.g. photo albums, split typing) into a single InboundMessage before dispatch.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Gateway module barrel documenting the channel-to-session routing architecture and re-exporting BindingStore, GatewayCommand, ResetPolicy, and GatewayService.

nodes.name: reset_policy.rs
nodes.summary: Session idle-reset policy (ResetMode/ResetPolicy) that GatewayInboundHandler consults on every inbound message to decide whether to recycle a chat binding.

nodes.name: wecom_ws_loop
nodes.summary: Long-lived task that connects, authenticates (aibot_subscribe), and runs the WeCom WebSocket read/write select loop with heartbeat and reconnect backoff.

nodes.name: wait_for_subscribe_ack
nodes.summary: Waits for the WeCom gateway to acknowledge the subscribe handshake within the configured timeout.

nodes.name: set_token
nodes.summary: Updates the stored auth token for a Weixin bot account.

nodes.name: dedup
nodes.summary: Deduplicates already-processed inbound Weixin message IDs to avoid reprocessing on poll overlap.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a WeixinChannel for one bot account with its HTTP client and shared state.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Begins the long-poll loop against the iLink Bot getupdates endpoint.

nodes.name: send
nodes.summary: Sends a reply through the iLink Bot sendmessage endpoint, tracking the per-peer context token.

nodes.name: poll_loop
nodes.summary: Background long-polling loop that fetches Weixin updates, deduplicates them, and hands them to process_inbound.

nodes.name: process_inbound
nodes.summary: Applies DM/group allowlist policy to a raw Weixin update and forwards an InboundMessage to the bus.

nodes.name: extract_text
nodes.summary: Extracts plain text content from a Weixin inbound update payload.

nodes.name: api_post
nodes.summary: Issues an authenticated POST to the iLink Bot API with token refresh handling.

nodes.name: random_wechat_uin
nodes.summary: Generates a randomized WeChat UIN placeholder used where the iLink API requires one.

nodes.name: WeixinState
nodes.summary: Shared mutable state for a Weixin account: current auth token and a dedup set of processed message IDs.

nodes.name: WeixinChannel
nodes.summary: Personal WeChat (Weixin) channel struct driving the iLink Bot long-poll loop; implements the Channel trait.

nodes.name: load_or_default
nodes.summary: Loads IntegrationsConfig from ~/.orgii/integrations.json, returning a fresh default if the file does not yet exist.

nodes.name: load_from
nodes.summary: Loads IntegrationsConfig from an arbitrary path, used by tests and callers that override the default location.

nodes.name: save
nodes.summary: Persists the current IntegrationsConfig to its default on-disk path.

nodes.name: save_to
nodes.summary: Persists the current IntegrationsConfig to an arbitrary path.

nodes.name: IntegrationsError
nodes.summary: Error enum for integrations.json read/write/parse failures.

nodes.name: IntegrationsConfig
nodes.summary: App-level, cross-agent config struct: channels, databases, nodes, web_search, mcp, embedding, and excluded skills.

nodes.name: WebSearchConfig
nodes.summary: API key and default settings for the web-search tool.

nodes.name: NodesConfig
nodes.summary: OS/desktop-tool node binding configuration.

nodes.name: SmitheryConfig
nodes.summary: Configuration for the Smithery MCP registry integration.

nodes.name: ExecutionMode
nodes.summary: Enum describing how automation/tooling execution is scoped.

nodes.name: EmbeddingConfig
nodes.summary: Semantic-memory embedding engine defaults (provider, model) used app-wide for the workspace index.

nodes.name: load_from_db
nodes.summary: Hydrates the in-memory binding map from SQLite at gateway startup.

nodes.name: set
nodes.summary: Writes a (channel,chat_id) to session_id binding both in-memory and to the SQLite table.

nodes.name: list_expired
nodes.summary: Returns bindings whose idle-reset policy has elapsed, for lazy reset checks on inbound messages.

nodes.name: clear
nodes.summary: Invalidates a binding both in-memory and in SQLite, used by /new and /reset slash commands.

nodes.name: ensure_table
nodes.summary: Creates the SQLite bindings table if it does not already exist.

nodes.name: SessionKey
nodes.summary: Pure-function binding key shape: {channel}:{chat_id}[:{sender_id}].

nodes.name: SessionBinding
nodes.summary: A single persisted binding record (key, session_id, timestamps).

nodes.name: BindingStore
nodes.summary: In-memory-plus-SQLite store mapping external chats to agent OS sessions, with idle-reset list/clear operations.

nodes.name: register_enabled_channels
nodes.summary: Iterates ChannelsConfig and registers every enabled channel account into the given ChannelManager.

nodes.name: build_channel_for_toggle
nodes.summary: Constructs a single channel instance by type for a runtime enable/disable toggle, mirroring the startup registration logic.

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Parses the first line of an inbound message into a GatewayCommand if it matches a recognized slash command.

nodes.name: GatewayCommand
nodes.summary: Enum of recognized gateway slash commands (New, Reset, Status, Compact, Help).

nodes.name: push
nodes.summary: Adds a message to a session's pending merge batch and resets its flush deadline.

nodes.name: drain_ready
nodes.summary: Drains and returns all pending batches whose flush deadline has elapsed.

nodes.name: merge_messages
nodes.summary: Concatenates a batch's pending messages into one InboundMessage, preserving the first message's metadata.

nodes.name: PendingMergeBatch
nodes.summary: Per-session pending message list plus flush deadline.

nodes.name: MergeBuffer
nodes.summary: Map of session keys to PendingMergeBatch, coalescing rapid-fire inbound messages before dispatch.

nodes.name: ResetMode
nodes.summary: Enum of session-reset triggers; currently only Idle is implemented.

nodes.name: ResetPolicy
nodes.summary: Idle-timeout reset policy consulted lazily on every inbound message to decide whether to recycle a chat binding.
